name: Major cyber incidents
summary: CISA added exploited VMware vCenter, SAP and Cisco flaws on 20 Nov; no national-scale attack
state: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities on 20 Nov, in Broadcom VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway and Apache Roller (CISA). Cyber incidents disrupted Monadnock Community Hospital in New Hampshire on 16 Nov and Vanderbilt University's Microsoft services on 17 Nov, with no common campaign identified (IBTimes, 18 Nov). Exploitation of widely used enterprise products keeps Watch.
for_you: Apply security updates promptly; follow NCSC guidance for organisations running affected products.
rubric_hit: Exploited flaws in widely used products = Watch

sources.title: IBTimes UK — Cyberattacks and outages in November: major US disruptions

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
